composition.thesis: Rhythm made visible: a single pulse/waveform line motif runs through the page as the visual spine, echoing the product's job (pacing releases into a predictable beat) instead of illustrating it literally with screenshots.
composition.signature_spatial_move: A full-bleed horizontal pulse line (inline SVG, animated dash-offset) crosses the hero asymmetrically and reappears, redrawn to fit each section's content, as the connective device between the 'how it works' steps — the same waveform, three different jobs.
composition.whitespace_strategy: Airy on marketing bands (hero, CTA), tightening to a comfortable mid rhythm in the feature/timeline sections where content density is higher — whitespace signals 'breathe here, work here'.
composition.familiar_pattern_avoided: Not a centered hero with a stock screenshot in a browser chrome mockup, and not three identical feature cards as the only idea — the bento feature grid and the horizontal timeline are two distinct layout models carrying two distinct jobs.

color_system.accent: #c8f24d — chartreuse/lime pulse, chosen specifically to avoid the indigo-to-magenta 'AI glow' band; reads as terminal/signal, not generic-AI
color_system.danger_or_notice: not used — no error/warning UI on a marketing page

families.display_body: system-ui sans stack (-apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif) — no remote fonts permitted
families.mono: ui-monospace stack (SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace) — used for labels, the code panel, and the footer build stamp

type_system.case_rule: all-caps reserved for short kicker labels only, never running text; line-height on those labels stays >= 1.0

spacing_system.density: airy on hero/CTA, mid inside feature/timeline content

motion_system.hero_device: pulse SVG path with animated stroke-dashoffset, 6s linear-in-a-loop-only (loop motion itself is fine to be constant-rate; entrance/state transitions never use linear)
motion_system.interactive: hover/focus transitions 180ms ease-out (transform + opacity only); focus ring appears instantly, never transitions in
motion_system.entrance: sections fade/rise 24px on scroll via IntersectionObserver, staggered ~60ms per item, ease-out, 400ms cap
motion_system.reduced_motion: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce collapses the pulse loop to a static path and disables scroll-entrance transforms (content renders in final state immediately)

icon_system.family: one hand-authored line-icon set, 24x24 viewBox, 1.75px stroke, round joins/caps — no emoji, no mixed sets
icon_system.usage: feature bento (3 icons), timeline steps (4 icons), footer/nav utility icons (menu, external-link)

depth_system.shadow_rule: shadows tinted toward base hue at low opacity, never pure black; one shadow OR one border per surface, not both stacked

structure.intent: wordmark + 3 nav links + secondary/primary CTA pair; gains a hairline bottom border + surface fill only after scroll (state, not decoration)

structure.layout_model: asymmetric split (60/40), full-bleed pulse line crossing behind both columns
structure.intent: kicker label ('release orchestration') + display headline stating the mechanism, not a slogan + subhead + CTA pair + a small live-looking terminal/code panel on the right showing a release-train config snippet as concrete proof of what the product actually is
three measured-sounding claims (deploy frequency, mean rollback time, adoption) instead of fabricated customer logos — avoids inventing unverifiable brand names while still building credibility

structure.layout_model: bento grid — one large feature (2/3 width) + two stacked (1/3 width)
structure.intent: three concrete mechanisms: release trains (scheduling), flag-timed rollout (control), automatic rollback net (safety) — each grounded in a specific behavior, not an adjective

structure.layout_model: horizontal 4-step timeline strung along a redrawn pulse line, distinct from the bento grid above it
structure.intent: connect config -> schedule -> ship -> auto-verify as one continuous beat; the repeated pulse motif is the connective tissue between this section and the hero, not a new idea invented for its own sake

structure.layout_model: editorial asymmetric quote block, oversized quotation glyph as the composition anchor
structure.intent: one illustrative, unattributed-to-any-real-person/company quote in a named role only ('Staff engineer, mid-size fintech') — deliberately generic attribution to avoid presenting a fabricated named endorsement as genuine

structure.layout_model: centered high-contrast band, pulse line closing/resolving to a flat line
structure.intent: restate the single primary action once; visual resolution of the pulse motif signals closure
wordmark, link groups, and a monospace build-stamp line (fictional version/commit style string) that reinforces the dev-tool register without naming any generator, model, or vendor
